candidates.summary: the case named `tests fixtures are not pulled in indirectly` never consults indirectExclude
candidates.failure_scenario: That case changes examples/gno.land/p/x/mid/v0/lib.gno, but the fixture realm gno.land/r/tests/vm/fixture imports base, not mid, so it is not a dependent and the `hasPrefixAny(p, indirectExclude)` skip at plan.go:244 is never reached. Emptying indirectExclude reddens `transitive dependency pulls both dependents` and `cap keeps the changed realm and reports the rest` and leaves this case green: the one case named after the rule is the one that does not exercise it, so a reader trusts a name the fixture does not back. candidates.summary: Pkg.Draft is parsed from every gnomod.toml and read by nothing, and no test notices
candidates.failure_scenario: modFlags parses `draft = true` and plan.go:142 stores it on every package, but grep over misc/gnopreview finds no reader of the field.
